U.note: Huge clear timer, progress bar, endAt-based timing, live region and Resume state, but adds persistence, presets, auto-start and clear-count that pad a simple timer.

V.note: Clean warm design with mode tabs, progress bar, pause state labelled, aria and live region; lean and well-scoped, only a small phone-width weakness.

W.note: Nice dark card with ring, but pause shows Start instead of Resume, no aria or live region or reduced motion, and no reset shortcut.

X.note: Best balance: ring with state text, Resume label, announced session end, aria-pressed tabs, undo on reset and shortcut hints, without bloat.

Y.note: Same dark-card ring as W with duration inputs; works but pause reads Start, no aria or live region, and a leftover dead expression in the dots code.

Z.note: Distinct monospace look but wordy status copy, two reset buttons and a confirm-to-reset step that made reset not work in one press; no visual progress and clumsy phone layout.
